title: Export embedded audio backing-track assets
scope: Write existing authored backing-track metadata and audio bytes into a valid GP8 archive.
acceptance: Use the existing enabled local audio fixture and preserve asset ID, embedded path, padding and bytes exactly.
The archive references an existing nonempty asset and the independent consumer retains enabled backing-track state.
Strict export accepts the implemented slice; missing assets, empty data and invalid frame boundaries fail without a partial file.
exclusions: Audio synthesis and playback are outside this library.

reproduction.instructions: Use the existing enabled local audio fixture and preserve asset ID, embedded path, padding and bytes exactly.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
